episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.summary: A beauty ranking pits boys against classmates. Pietro accepts a bet and a basketball challenge. The principal gives an important communication.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.summary: Determined to give her first kiss, Isabel sets her sights on Daniele. Then 2D and 3D face off on the basketball court - who will win?

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.summary: Daniele feels better after talking to Isabel - but will he find the courage to tell Mirko what he feels? 2D returns to the field in search of a rematch.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.summary: Livia's mind works tirelessly thinking about the upcoming race and how to help Daniele. Giulio develops a crazy app for a class project.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.summary: Approaching Arianna, Pietro has almost won the bet - but in this way he puts his friendship with Giulio at risk. Livia makes a crucial decision.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.summary: Eager for some privacy, Isabel asks her parents for a room of her own. Meanwhile, everyone is ready to go to Arianna's party - except Monica.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.summary: Students have new experiences during a two day trip to Rome - too bad they brought the same old problems with them.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.summary: There is an air of love and despair when Daniele makes a new meeting and a bad joke breaks Monica's heart. Time to take revenge.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.summary: Monica and Giulio are poles apart, but they have to study together. Pietro is punished for a graffiti that he did not do. Will friends be able to prove his innocence?

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.summary: Giulio has a lot to do. While hunting down the real graffiti artist, he must face his own diagnosis and try to win the girl of his dreams of him.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.summary: Livia is done with the boys, she prefers to concentrate on the triathlon final - but this will not stop Pietro who wants to try to conquer her.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.summary: Arianna is looking for someone who can really listen. Maybe she should give Giulio a chance? Isabel and Monica give their friend good advice.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.summary: Mirko makes a deal to get two passes for Tancredi's event, one for himself and one for Daniele. The next day there is a big surprise at school.

episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.summary: Pietro's parents are divorcing and he is really sick. When an injury stops him before an important match, he must find a replacement immediately.

episodes.title: Episodio 15
episodes.summary: Missing a week at the end of the school year and everything is perfect - or almost. The only thing left to do is save the school, but how?

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.summary: Everything feels different on the first day back to school. Pietro makes an effort to reconnect with Livia, while the new classmates keep their distance.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.summary: Livia is clearly changing: new hairstyle, new attitude, new friends. In fact, her classmates are worried she's taking it too far.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.summary: Isa decides to take control of her life. Can she balance helping Pietro while getting closer to Roby? Meanwhile, Katia and Sara give Arianna a hard time.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.summary: As soon as Bianca feels like she finally fits in, she receives life-changing news. Torn between her future and her happiness, she finds support in Mirko.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.summary: While Arianna gets bullied on social media, Dani loses confidence about his dancing skills. Isa wonders if she's making the right decision with Roby.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.summary: When Katia and Sara cross the line with Arianna, it's her classmates' time for action. A new crush keeps Pietro distracted and frustrated.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.summary: With the magic of Christmas approaching, Pietro finally finds the courage to make a move. During a party, the friends make wishes around the tree.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.summary: Final exams approach and tensions run high as the friends realize that their roads will separate. Livia feels that something's still off with Arianna.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.summary: Unable to patch things up with Pietro and with his father trying to determine his future, Giulio decides to take control of his life.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.summary: School reports bring Pietro and Livia together in a remedial class. Meanwhile, Livia faces the consequences of distancing herself from Katia and Sara.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.summary: When Dani says he is seeing someone, Mirko starts acting weird. Bianca finds comfort in Livia, who is still unsure about Pietro.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.summary: Isa's attempts to reconnect with Livia seem to be in vain. Unlike Giulio, Monica is excited about Manuel's upcoming visit. The whole class gets pranked.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.summary: The group plans how to take revenge on Sara, Katia and Roby. Giulio opens up to Monica, while Pietro forgets a key date that makes him reflect on Isa.

episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.summary: The friends embark on a trip together the day before final exams. When things go wrong, Pietro, Livia, Isa, Giulio and Monica deal with uncertainties.
